selected_evidence.requirement: CA 'OS Comparison Root CA' created on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Generated CA key/cert; openssl x509 shows subject=issuer=CN=OS Comparison Root CA, 10-year validity.

selected_evidence.requirement: CA certificate installed as trusted system CA
selected_evidence.summary: Installed openssl/ca-certificates packages, copied cert to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates and ran update-ca-certificates; symlinks ca-cert-os-comparison-root-ca.pem and hash ca763292.0 created in /etc/ssl/certs.
Extracted CA subject from the combined trust bundle and confirmed 'OS Comparison Root CA' is present; issued a leaf cert and openssl verify -CApath /etc/ssl/certs returned OK.
Captured boot_id 5fb51002-fee2-4de5-a43d-805c7a885423 and uptime before restart.
Backgrounded reboot command acknowledged (exit_code 0, 'reboot-scheduled') before the connection dropped.
After connection-reset/timeout errors during reboot, boot_id read as 7d5b05a1-8d35-4a47-86b8-618257329650, differing from the pre-restart value.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of CA/trust state
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed CA cert files persisted and remained in the system trust bundle post-reboot; issued and verified a new leaf certificate (openssl verify OK), proving functional recovery.
